description:
Vintage 14K Gold Italian Braided Herringbone Chain Bracelet.
The item shown is a vintage Italian braided herringbone chain bracelet. It features an intricate multi-strand woven flat design and is stamped with "ITALY" on its heart-shaped structural end tab, which connects the main chain to the lobster claw clasp.
These classic bracelets were highly popular imports from Italian jewelry manufacturers throughout the late 20th century. While some variations are made of solid 14K or 18K yellow gold, many similar vintage pieces were crafted from 925 sterling silver plated in gold (vermeil).
The heart-shaped end tab features a clear hallmark consisting of "14K" enclosed inside a diamond-shaped border. This tells you two important things:
Gold Purity: The "14K" stamp indicates that the metal is 58.3% pure gold mixed with alloy metals for strength and durability, which is the standard hallmark for fine jewelry in the United States.
Maker's Mark: The diamond outline serves as the manufacturer's trademark or maker's mark, indicating the specific Italian workshop that produced the piece for export.

description:
18K Gold CT Pair of Emerald Solitaire Stud Earrings Set in a Classic Four-prong Yellow Gold Basket.
This lot shows a stunning pair of emerald solitaire stud earrings set in a classic four-prong yellow gold basket.
The engraving on your earring post reads "18K CT".
Here is what these two distinct hallmark stamps mean:
18K: This indicates the metal purity of the earrings. 18K gold is a premium jewelry alloy made of 75% pure gold and 25% other metals, offering a richer yellow color and higher value than standard 10K or 14K gold.
CT: This is a manufacturer or designer hallmark. It stands for the maker's mark or brand registered by the company that manufactured the piece, serving as their signature. (Note: While "ct" is the abbreviation for carat weight, it is not stamped onto small earring posts to indicate stone size, as stone weights vary by individual pair and are instead detailed on tags or jewelry certificates).
Refer to pictures for more details, overall size and condition. Tape measurements are shown in the pictures.

description:
Lot of 5 Vintage Glass Electrical Insulators Hemingray Blue Green Clear
This lot includes 5 vintage glass electrical insulators featuring both aqua/blue-green and clear glass varieties. Two blue-green insulators are marked with 'HEMINGRAY' and 'MADE IN U.S.A.'. Each insulator is made of heavy, thick glass with a classic double-groove design. Most pieces exhibit signs of age including minor dirt, residue, and surface wear but have no major cracks or chips visible. The clear glass insulators include one with a partial label and some with embossed markings. These insulators were originally used on telegraph and power lines and are suitable for collectors or as decorative industrial items.
9 x 8 x 4 in

Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites

Natural Stone Collection
Polished Agate and Amethyst Specimens - Brazil Origin
Vintage Collection, 7 Pieces
This assembly of geological specimens highlights the diverse mineralogy of South American deposits, specifically those of Brazil. Included are three distinct macrocrystalline quartz specimens (agate), each cut and polished to reveal concentric chalcedony banding and translucent crystalline centers. The collection is further enhanced by amethyst in both its raw druzy form and a polished hexagonal point, representing the purple variety of quartz colored by iron impurities. A polished pink stone egg and a small black mineral specimen complete the set.
3 Polished Agate display chunks/bookends in teal, blue, and earth tones
1 Amethyst Druzy cluster with deep purple crystalline surface
1 Polished Amethyst Obelisk point
1 Polished Pink Stone Egg specimen
1 Small Black mineral specimen (Tourmaline style)
Original "Made in Brazil" label present on blue agate specimen
Total set weight: 9.4 lbs
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. Polished surfaces maintain a high-gloss finish. Natural inclusions, internal fractures, and minor surface pitting are characteristic of geological specimens and are not considered defects. The amethyst druzy retains sharp, well-defined crystals. No significant modern damage or repairs noted.

description:
Ancient & Historical Artifact Lot
Stone Projectile Points and Clay Pipe Fragments
17 Items, Mixed Age and Origin
This collection features a diverse assortment of lithic artifacts and historical clay pipe components. The stone pieces display varying degrees of bifacial flaking, pressure flaking, and retouching across multiple chert and flint varieties. The inclusion of early clay pipe fragments suggests a broad chronological range, potentially spanning from prehistoric indigenous cultures to historical-era trade goods.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Large Chert Blade
- Light grey chert with significant bifacial thinning and shaped edge.
2.
Projectile Points (14)
- Assorted sizes and styles including side-notched, corner-notched, and stemmed bases in grey, tan, and reddish-brown stone.
3.
Reeded Clay Pipe Bowl
- Terracotta-colored clay with vertical fluting or reeded decorative pattern.
4.
Clay Pipe Stem Fragment
- Smooth, curved section of a clay pipe stem in similar terracotta-toned material.
Materials: Chert, flint, and fired clay
Construction: Knapped stone tools; molded and fired ceramics
Dimensions: Approximately 6" x 4" x 3" lot footprint (provided)
Condition:
Mixed artifact condition. Stone points show expected weathering and varying degrees of edge wear; some tips or bases may show ancient or modern breaks consistent with find-site artifacts. Clay pipe fragments are incomplete sections (bowl and stem). Surface patina and soil staining present throughout consistent with excavated or field-found materials.

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping

cannot be adjusted or discounted
.

Shipping via FedEx:

The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Framed Agate Slice Shadow Box
Natural Banded Agate, Purple and White
Vintage Style Decor, 11 x 9 Inches
This decorative shadow box features a genuine natural agate slice suspended within a crisp white mat. The slice showcases striking concentric banding in shades of deep purple and translucent white, characteristic of high-quality chalcedony specimens. The deep black frame provides a modern contrast, making it a sophisticated addition to any gallery wall, office, or home decor collection.
Natural banded agate slice with organic edges and crystalline center
Deep purple color transitions into lighter lavender and white bands
Professional shadow box framing with a high-contrast white mat
Integrated sawtooth hanger on the reverse for easy wall mounting
Dimensions: 11 inches length, 9 inches width, 2 inches depth
Condition:
The agate slice and internal mat are in excellent condition. The black frame shows some minor surface scuffing and small chips along the outer edges consistent with handling. The paper backing on the reverse side has a small tear in the lower corner as shown in photos. Glass is clear and intact.

Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites

The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called dimensional weight and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight.
For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of Northeast Iowa, Inc. will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, so please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for large and pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping:
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.
PLEASE NOTE: electronics, glass, and other fragile items do not qualify for combined shipping.
Refused/Unclaimed Packages:
If an item is returned as unclaimed or not deliverable, we will contact the customer at the email address listed on their ShopGoodwill.com account to notify them of the return. The customer will then have seven (7) days to pay additional shipping charges for the item to be resent. If we have not received payment within those seven (7) days, the item will be relisted and prior payment will be considered a charitable contribution.

description:
Natural Trilobite Fossil
Stone Matrix Specimen
Paleozoic Era
This impressive trilobite fossil is preserved within its natural stone matrix, displaying the characteristic segmented exoskeleton of these ancient marine arthropods. The specimen features a well-defined thoracic region and cephalon, highlighted by a hand-tooled border prepared in the surrounding sedimentary stone to emphasize the fossil's biological form. As a representative of the Paleozoic Era, this piece offers a tangible connection to Earth's prehistoric oceans and early biological diversity.
Natural fossil specimen embedded in sedimentary stone matrix
Detailed thoracic segments and cephalon structure visible on the dorsal surface
Manually prepared border carved into the matrix to highlight the central specimen
Dimensions: 6.5" L x 6" W x 1" H; Weight: 2.1 lbs
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. The fossil is structurally sound within the matrix with no visible structural repairs or artificial reconstructions. The stone matrix remains solid with natural mineral variations and ochre-toned oxidation consistent with geological aging. Enhance your collection or decor with this striking Hemingray No 40 glass insulator, featuring a vivid aqua blue hue and a classic dome shape. The embossed Hemingray No 40 marking and its solid, pressed glass construction exude vintage industrial charm, making it an ideal addition for collectors or anyone drawn to historic utility glassware. The insulator's robust design and glossy finish reflect the manufacturing techniques widely used in the United States in the early-to-mid 20th century.
